response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT sex, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY sex) SELECT sex, avg_alb, avg_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages) AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages);

assumptions.assumption: A per-test UN/T-BIL ratio is missing when T-BIL is zero, so AVG ignores it.
